title: Fox sends Out of the Blue to all 535 members of Congress
summary: James Fox tells of Fox sends Out of the Blue to all 535 members of Congress, about c. 2000 at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I went around and I gave out copies of out of the blue to every single member of the House and Senate

plain: James Fox, a UFO investigator and filmmaker, says that around 2000 he went around Washington, D.C., handing out copies of his UFO documentary Out of the Blue to every member of the House and Senate, all 535 of them. He tells it as his attempt to get the US Congress to take the subject seriously.
